sources.title: Unsloth - Run and Train Models Locally
sources.snippet: Connect Claude Code, Codex and other agents to local models with the unsloth start command. Start Unsloth, load a model, open your project folder, then run unsloth start claude.

sources.title: Unsloth Desktop - Learn AI
sources.snippet: Unsloth Desktop v0.1.701-beta launched on August 11, 2026, as the first desktop application to combine model training, fine-tuning, inference, model management, agent connectivity, and remote access in a single native application.

sources.title: Introducing Unsloth Desktop | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Introducing Unsloth Desktop Unsloth Desktop (Beta) is a free, open-source app for running and training AI models on your own local hardware. Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Unsloth lets you run, train and deploy LLMs, diffusion image/video, MLX, GGUF and audio models. Download Features GitHub
